list.name: mentee
list.label: Менти
list.query: SELECT me.telegram_id AS __value, COALESCE(me.doc_name, u.name, u.username, 'ID: ' || me.telegram_id::text) AS __text FROM iam.mentees me JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = me.telegram_id AND u.is_placeholder = false WHERE me.telegram_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY __text

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.name, u.username, 'Не назначен') AS "Ментор"
FROM iam.mentees me
LEFT JOIN iam.mentors mt ON mt.id = me.mentor_id
LEFT JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = mt.telegram_id
WHERE me.telegram_id = $mentee

SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT c.value
   FROM integrations.user_cohorts uc
   JOIN integrations.cohorts c ON c.id = uc.cohort_id AND c.type = 'Status'
   WHERE uc.user_telegram_id = $mentee
   LIMIT 1),
  'Не определена'
) AS "Стадия"

SELECT me.student_score AS "Балл"
FROM iam.mentees me
WHERE me.telegram_id = $mentee

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meeting_users mu
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = mu.meeting_id
WHERE mu.user_id = $mentee
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT
  CASE WHEN me.contract THEN 'Да' ELSE 'Нет' END
  || COALESCE(' (до ' || me.contract_expires || ')', '') AS "Контракт"
FROM iam.mentees me
WHERE me.telegram_id = $mentee

WITH stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    COALESCE(
      LEAD(created_at) OVER (ORDER BY created_at),
      now()
    ) AS ended_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE user_telegram_id = $mentee
    AND cohort_type = 'Status'
)
SELECT
  sp.stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS "Созвонов"
FROM stage_periods sp
JOIN meetings.meeting_users mu ON mu.user_id = $mentee
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = mu.meeting_id
  AND m.scheduled_at >= sp.started_at
  AND m.scheduled_at < sp.ended_at
GROUP BY sp.stage
ORDER BY MIN(sp.started_at)

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', m.scheduled_at) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meeting_users mu
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = mu.meeting_id
WHERE mu.user_id = $mentee
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  to_char(st.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') AS "Дата",
  COALESCE(st.old_value, '(новый)') AS "Из",
  st.new_value AS "В",
  st.cohort_type AS "Тип когорты"
FROM integrations.stage_transitions st
WHERE st.user_telegram_id = $mentee
ORDER BY st.created_at DESC
